info.title: OpenGrants Gateway API
info.description: Read-only access to Web3 grant funding data in the DAOIP-5 standard: grant systems (funding programs), grant pools (rounds), grant applications (awards) and projects. Includes every Stellar Community Fund (SCF) round. Anonymous access is rate-limited (20 requests/minute); an API key raises the limit.

tags.name: projects
tags.description: Projects that applied for or received grants

get.description: List the grant systems (funding programs) indexed by OpenGrants. Start here to find valid `system` values.

parameters.name: system
parameters.description: Grant system to query. Use "scf" for the Stellar Community Fund, "octant" or "giveth". Omit to query all systems.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, 1–100 (default 10).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of records to skip (default 0). Use with limit to page through results.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: DAOIP-5 grant system ID, e.g. "daoip5:scf". URL-encode it (":" becomes "%3A").

parameters.name: system
parameters.description: Grant system to query. Use "scf" for the Stellar Community Fund, "octant" or "giveth". Omit to query all systems.

get.description: List funding rounds, optionally filtered by system, open/closed state or funding mechanism. SCF rounds are named like "SCF #45".

parameters.name: system
parameters.description: Grant system to query. Use "scf" for the Stellar Community Fund, "octant" or "giveth". Omit to query all systems.

parameters.name: isOpen
parameters.description: true = only open rounds, false = only closed rounds.

parameters.name: mechanism
parameters.description: Funding mechanism, e.g. "Direct Grants", "Quadratic Funding".

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Field to sort by.

parameters.name: sortOrder
parameters.description: Sort direction.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, 1–100 (default 10).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of records to skip (default 0). Use with limit to page through results.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: DAOIP-5 grant pool ID, e.g. "daoip-5:scf:grantPool:scf_#45". URL-encode it (":" becomes "%3A").

parameters.name: system
parameters.description: Grant system to query. Use "scf" for the Stellar Community Fund, "octant" or "giveth". Omit to query all systems.

get.description: List grant applications with amounts awarded and paid. Filter by round (poolId) or project (projectId) — e.g. all SCF awards to one project: system=scf&projectId=daoip-5:scf:project:stellar_light. To get every award for a project, pass system together with projectId. Otherwise always pass poolId: without it, results come from a single default round, which is not necessarily the most recent.

parameters.name: system
parameters.description: Grant system to query. Use "scf" for the Stellar Community Fund, "octant" or "giveth". Omit to query all systems.

parameters.name: poolId
parameters.description: Only applications to this grant pool (round) ID.

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description: Only applications from this project ID.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: DAOIP-5 application status.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Field to sort by.

parameters.name: sortOrder
parameters.description: Sort direction.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, 1–100 (default 10).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of records to skip (default 0). Use with limit to page through results.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: DAOIP-5 grant application ID, e.g. "daoip-5:scf:application:stellar_light". URL-encode it (":" becomes "%3A").

parameters.name: system
parameters.description: Grant system to query. Use "scf" for the Stellar Community Fund, "octant" or "giveth". Omit to query all systems.
